parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem:
Fig. 1.1 is a transmission electron micrograph of cells from the leaf of a plant.
{{figure:figure_1_1.png}}

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: State **two** ways in which the structure of an animal cell differs from plant cells such as those shown in Fig. 1.1.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
Cell structure **Y** in Fig. 1.1 contains a large starch granule (grain).

Name the chemical reagent used to test for starch **and** state the colour change that will be seen if starch is present.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
Starch granules contain amylose and amylopectin.

Describe the similarities **and** differences between the structure of amylose and the structure of amylopectin.
